stories.title: Remove dead code (self.connection backward compat)
stories.description: Remove `self.connection = None` from CryptoAccounts.__init__. Tests were updated during SQL-009 to use backend abstraction, so backward compatibility is no longer needed.
acceptance_criteria: No references to self.connection remain in codebase

stories.title: Complete deposit/withdrawal import execution
stories.description: In import_transactions(), the Deposit and Withdrawal cases define a query but never execute it. Complete the implementation to execute the queries.
acceptance_criteria: Deposit transactions are imported correctly with query execution
Withdrawal transactions are imported correctly with query execution
Remove misleading comments about incomplete code

stories.title: Fix module-level now timestamp
stories.description: Replace module-level `now = datetime.now()` with `None` defaults and runtime evaluation. Methods with `now` as default parameter should evaluate datetime.now() at call time, not import time.
acceptance_criteria: Methods using now as default use None with runtime fallback

stories.title: Consistency in balance methods
stories.description: get_balance() excludes 'Stake' transactions via BalanceCalculator, but get_balance_by_account() doesn't. Make them consistent by adding Stake exclusion to get_balance_by_account().

stories.title: Extract duplicate wallet filtering logic
stories.description: The wallet filtering logic for trade/interest purchases is duplicated between get_sales_for_1099b() and forecast_capital_gains_fifo(). Extract to a private helper method.
acceptance_criteria: All existing 1099b and forecast tests pass

stories.title: Remove legacy exchange-specific import methods
stories.description: Remove legacy import methods for exchanges no longer used (Nexo, ADA, RVN mining, etc.) from cryptoAccounts.py.

stories.title: Create Bitcoin wallet imports module
stories.description: Create a new wallet_imports.py module with import functions for common Bitcoin hardware and software wallets (Ledger, Trezor, Sparrow, Coldcard).
